### Image
Enhanced image container with placeholder graphics, loading skeletons, error fallbacks, radius options, zoomable hover effects, and blurred glow backdrop shadow.

**Import Path**:
```typescript
import { Image } from "@/components/ui/image/image";
```

#### Default
Standard image with rounded-2xl borders and caption.

```tsx
<Image
  src="https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1506744038136-46273834b3fb?w=800&auto=format&fit=crop&q=80"
  alt="Mountain landscape"
  caption="Serene mountain vista at sunrise"
/>
```

#### Placeholder Graphic
Use the 'placeholder' prop to render a default vector SVG placeholder.

```tsx
<Image placeholder aspectRatio="video" caption="Standard vector placeholder SVG" />
```

#### Zoomable Hover Effect
Enable smooth zoom animation on hover using the 'isZoomable' prop.

```tsx
<Image src="https://images.unsplash.com/..." alt="..." isZoomable />
```

#### Aspect Ratios
Control container dimensions using the 'aspectRatio' prop: 'square', 'video', '4/3', or '21/9'.

```tsx
<Image src="https://images.unsplash.com/..." aspectRatio="square" />
<Image src="https://images.unsplash.com/..." aspectRatio="video" />
```

#### Lightbox Zoom Modal, Progressive Blur-up & Fallback URL
Click an image with 'enableLightbox' to open full-screen lightbox preview, show smooth low-res blur-up placeholders, and recover with 'fallbackSrc' when primary image URL fails.

```tsx
<Image src="..." enableLightbox caption="Click for lightbox modal" />
<Image src="broken.jpg" fallbackSrc="https://..." caption="URL Recovery fallback" />
```

#### Props — Image
Supported properties for the Image component.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| enableLightbox | boolean | false | Opens full-screen lightbox modal on click preview. |
| fallbackSrc | string | — | Backup image source loaded automatically if main URL fails. |
| blurUpPlaceholder | string | — | Low-res placeholder image URL displayed with blur effect during load. |
| placeholder | boolean | false | Renders the default placeholder vector SVG graphic. |
